name: Customer engagement invisible in CRM
description: A customer has recently contacted the business about a quote, but the CRM contains no corresponding recent internal activity.

primary_only.interpretation: Potential follow-up gap caused by customer inactivity or missing follow-up.

cross_system.interpretation: The customer recently engaged, while the CRM shows no corresponding internal activity. The issue is more likely an internal follow-up or activity-recording gap than customer inactivity.

expected.recommendation: Verify the communication and follow up with the opportunity owner.
